text:
alex: Quick sync idea 1: run a 'remediation lighthouse' pilot to reduce stale actions and make ownership explicit. short sketch below.

maria: curious, how's this different from the tracker?

alex: two upgrades: 1) timed beacons (72h / 14d / 45d) that post structured check-ins; 2) enforced ack/escalation: owner must ack within 24h or it escalates to secondary then rota lead.

sam: template for the check-in?

alex: 72h note format: "Status / Blocker / Next step + ETA / Owner (secondary) / Risk 1-5 / Reproducible?" one-line each.

june: ops-bot work? can it create reminders and require reaction ack?

ops-bot: scheduled: beacon-72h will ping owner and thread; owner has 24h to react with :white_check_mark: before escalation.

maria: recurring-incidents pattern? we keep missing that.

alex: auto-pattern detect: open review if same error signature occurs 3x within 60d. pattern-review kicks a cross-team sync and a 30d mitigation plan.

sam: dashboard needs: beacons view with columns: lane, owner, age, next_beacon, stuck>48h flag, pattern-flag.

june: pilot scope?

alex: sev >= P1 for 6 weeks, then retro.

maria: actions: alex write pilot doc (Fri), june add ops-bot hooks (Mon), sam dashboard mock (Wed).

alex: will post doc in #eng-oncall and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
